systems.system: EMIS surveys and survey data sets
systems.country_label: EMIS surveys; annual survey data sets
systems.owner: Department of Basic Education, Education Management Information Systems (EMIS)
systems.tiers: each institution returns a survey, identified by its national EMIS number; provinces hold number ranges; national department sets the codes

note: A gazetted coding standard (June 2011) for education survey data sets: its master enrolment table captures the number of learners at each institution by grade and gender per survey year, on paper or electronic instruments, which is a return of counts; it describes no per-learner record that schools add to.
